record.title: Revalidate the complete typed SCPI plan before stream operations
record.intent: Keep the read-only query boundary valid even for unchecked caller-constructed model instances.
requirements: Preserve the in-memory reproducer showing an unchecked option selector can currently emit extra command text without contacting any endpoint.
Validate supported query alternatives selector values and bounded finite limits from primitives before encoding or any stream write; reject the whole invalid plan with no partial submission.
Reconcile direct codec entrypoints and session preflight so public boundaries reject invalid typed records without private-value diagnostics or serializer warnings.
Preserve canonical bytes for all supported query alternatives and existing serial execution progress semantics.
acceptance: Unchecked malformed models cannot broaden the allowlisted wire grammar or disable bounds and all failures precede I/O.
